## About

Piyush Paul is an AI/ML Developer and Cybersecurity Engineer specializing in agentic AI systems, autonomous penetration testing pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, DPDK high-performance networking, and full-stack backend engineering. MLH Hack Days Winner 2026. Based in West Bengal, India.

## Projects

- [AstroRoni](https://astroroni.com): Full-stack Vedic astrology platform with NASA ephemeris-based Kundli generation, 36 Guna matching, numerology, and NRI-friendly consultation booking.
- [RiskRadar](https://riskradar.piyushpaul.com): Vulnerability detection and alerting software that tracks CVEs and notifies users when their products are affected.
- [HTTP Header Security Analyzer](https://github.com/Piyush800x/header-analyzer): Production-ready Flask REST API that audits website HTTP security headers with A–F grading and severity-ranked remediation recommendations.
- [Online Exam Panel](https://exam-panel.piyushpaul.com): Fully automated examination platform with admin controls, flexible exam creation, and instant result delivery.
- [TimeZonesNow](https://timezone.piyushpaul.com): World clock and time zone converter — 2nd Place winner at Code Circuit Frontend Hackathon.

## Hackathon Projects

- [ARTA — Autonomous Red Team Agent](https://github.com/Piyush800x/arta): 🏆 MLH Hack Days Winner 2026. Autonomous penetration testing pipeline powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash — multi-agent system for target discovery, CVE analysis, and exploit validation.
- [PacketForge](https://github.com/samiranpal2004/PacketForge-main): 🥈 Synchronicity S2 1st Runner-Up 2026. DPDK-based dual-NIC packet scrubber sustaining 470K packets/sec for DDoS mitigation.
- [NeighbourNet](https://github.com/sudipta57/NeighbourNet2): 🥈 MLH HackTropica 1st Runner-Up 2026. Offline mesh SOS communication system using BLE/WiFi Direct for disaster scenarios.
